title: Movie
description: Film or motion picture with director, cast information, genre, release year, duration, ratings, financial data, and poster. Used for movie databases, streaming platforms, and cinema management systems.

description.description: Plot summary or synopsis of the movie

director.description: Full name of the movie director

genre.description: Movie genre (e.g., Action, Drama, Comedy, Horror, Sci-Fi, Thriller)

year.description: Year when the movie was released

rating.description: Average rating from critics or audiences, typically on a scale of 1-10

language.description: Primary language code of the movie (e.g., en, es, fr)

country.description: Country of origin or primary production country

revenue.description: Total box office revenue or gross earnings in USD

poster.description: URL to the movie poster image

released_at.description: Official release date of the movie
